text: GTA 6 album details: - Partnership with Atlantic Records, launches Nov 19 - Pre-save on all major streaming services - Limited-edition vinyl & CD sets pre-order for $50 - 34 original tracks, 6 out today: Yung Lean, Travis Scott, CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, PinkPantheress, Fred again & Etienne de Crécy, Morgan Wallen, Rauw Alejandro, Keith Richards - Captures the energy of Vice City and Leonida - 3 physical editions: liquid-filled vinyl, splatter vinyl, CD jewel case - Exclusive vinyl colorways at major retailers @RockstarGames 😠
@RockstarGames reveals the GTA 6 album, coming November 19 with 34 tracks and a physical vinyl edition. 6 songs are available today. @RockstarGames 😠
Spotify is working with @RockstarGames on GTA 6’s soundtrack, as they started advertising with the new artwork that was released by multiple artists yesterday. @RockstarGames 😠

We really got 6 new GTA 6 artworks out of nowhere today. Expecting more artists to tease their collaborations with Rockstar but so far, the following artists have teased their involvement: - Travis Scott - Future - Yung Lean - PinkPantheress - Metro Boomin - Rolling Stones’ Keith Richards - Morgan Wallen - CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso - Raúl Alejandro - Fred again @RockstarGames 😠
